pull.title: Add ProtCell from #350
pull.body:
Adds the entity records requested in #350. Refs #350: the issue stays open, because its tier asks for evaluations too, which wait for #274.

Entities only, until the claims recollection (#274): no evaluation, result or claim. Every record has status `discovered` and carries its review receipt; nothing here has had an independent review yet.

**Records**

- `intake-350-20261121-model-protcell` (model, depth tier 3)

**Sources**

- https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.64898/2026.10.22.760932v1: `intake-350-20261121-source-protcell-a-foundation-model-for-single-cell-proteomics-biorx`, SHA-256 f03aeb298cbdf3d75727e35083342f76d9047af40489a49e40faf61f12cb8e40, text/html

**Not added**

- None.

**Links**

- None.

**Possible duplicates in the store**

- None.

The knowledge graph release 2026-11-21-82c4be3e6b5e was searched for possible duplicates and link targets, and the batch was written through its draft overlay (rdf-kg-mcp), which checked each record and link against the release.

Batch folder: `data/omics/intake-350-20261121`. Its `notes.md` lists every proposed field and whether the verification pass confirmed it; `kg.json` lists every link and duplicate ruling with its locator.

**Checks.** The agent ran `npm run records -- add` (including the SHACL subset check), `npm run records -- check`, and a check that `normalizeAttributes` leaves every record unchanged and that each depth tier matches the rule in docs/tiers.md. The source bytes are hashed but not yet in the archive object store.

**Cost.** Estimated $0.0267; 4 model calls; wall-clock 114 s. Run: https://github.com/rewire-bio/rewire-benchmark-data/actions/runs/44922537391
